name: GitHub CI/CD 密钥配置自动化
desc: 通过细粒度访问令牌自动完成 GitHub 仓库 CI/CD 配置：写入 Actions Secrets（公钥加密）、经 Git Data API 推送代码与 workflow、在无手动触发时用空提交触发部署流水线，并验证线上站点可访问。适配 github.com 网页与 git 通道不可达、仅 api.github.com 可达的网络环境。
desc_en: Automate GitHub repo CI/CD setup with a fine-grained PAT: write Actions secrets (public-key encrypted), push code & workflows via Git Data API, trigger pipelines with an empty commit when no manual trigger exists, and verify site reachability. Works when github.com web/git channels are unreachable and only api.github.com is reachable.
input: 目标仓库 owner/repo、具备 Secrets=Read and write 的 Fine-grained PAT、需写入的密钥名值对；可选：待推送文件路径（自动排除 .github/workflows 的先后顺序策略）
input_en: Target repo owner/repo, fine-grained PAT with Secrets=Read and write, secret key-value pairs to write; optional: file paths to push (with ordering strategy that pushes .github/workflows last)
output: 密钥写入结果与更新时间、新提交 SHA、CI run 状态与链接、线上站点 HTTP 可访问性
output_en: Secret write results with timestamps, new commit SHA, CI run status & URL, and live site HTTP reachability
features: Actions Secrets 公钥加密写入（libsodium sealed box）
Git Data API 推送代码与 workflow（绕过被重置的 git 通道）
空提交触发 push 型 workflow
细粒度 PAT 权限自动诊断（403 归因与指引）
CI 运行轮询与线上站点验证
features_en: Actions secrets write with public-key encryption (libsodium sealed box)
Push code & workflows via Git Data API (bypasses reset git channel)
Trigger push-type workflows with an empty commit
Fine-grained PAT permission diagnosis (403 attribution & guidance)
CI run polling and live site verification
usageGuide: 前置：1) 准备 Fine-grained PAT，并在 GitHub Developer settings 中授予目标仓库 Secrets=Read and write（仅 Administration 不够，写 secrets 会 403）；2) 确认目标仓库存在。执行：A. 写 Secrets——GET /actions/secrets/public-key 取公钥与 key_id，用 PyNaCl nacl.bindings.crypto_box_seal 加密明文，PUT /actions/secrets/{name} 提交 {encrypted_value, key_id}；B. 推代码——GET /git/ref/heads/main 取 base，逐个 POST /git/blobs（base64），POST /git/trees（带 base_tree），POST /git/commits，PATCH /git/refs/heads/main；先推业务代码、最后推 .github/workflows，避免 secrets 未配时 workflow 失败；C. 触发——deploy.yml 无 workflow_dispatch 时创建与当前 tree 相同的空 commit 推送触发；D. 验证——轮询 /actions/runs 至 completed=success，再请求 Pages 站点确认 HTTP 200。
usageGuide_en: Prereq: 1) Create a fine-grained PAT and grant Secrets=Read and write on the target repo in GitHub Developer settings (Administration alone is NOT enough; writing secrets will 403); 2) Target repo must exist. Steps: A. Write secrets—GET /actions/secrets/public-key for key & key_id, encrypt with PyNaCl nacl.bindings.crypto_box_seal, PUT /actions/secrets/{name} with {encrypted_value, key_id}; B. Push code—GET /git/ref/heads/main for base, POST /git/blobs (base64) per file, POST /git/trees with base_tree, POST /git/commits, PATCH /git/refs/heads/main; push business code first and .github/workflows last to avoid failing workflows before secrets exist; C. Trigger—when no workflow_dispatch exists, push an empty commit sharing the current tree; D. Verify—poll /actions/runs until completed=success, then request the Pages site for HTTP 200.
